answer.thought: The silence in the bungalow is heavy, a physical weight that presses against the white cotton of my kurta. Hegde stands in the corner, a ghost of the man who was meant to be here, while Ramesh watches me with the quiet patience of a debt unpaid. I am hungry, the last meal a memory of yesterday, but the house is cold and the coin in my pocket is too few to command a meal now. I will rest my eyes on the page, letting the stillness pass through me like a draft.
